hook: Your rocket booster lands upright on its own legs.
title: A Rocket Landed Itself Standing Upright
description:
In December 2015, SpaceX's Falcon 9 first stage touched down upright on a landing pad. It was the first orbital rocket booster to do it. Before that, boosters were thrown away after one flight.

#Shorts #SpaceX #Rockets
comment_prompt: Rocket or jet, which is cooler?

scenes.headline: ROCKET STANDS UPRIGHT

scenes.narration: In December 2015, Falcon 9 did exactly that.
scenes.headline: DECEMBER 2015

scenes.narration: First orbital rocket ever to manage it.
